tagline: A next-generation business model combining boutique investment qualities with the benefits of an integrated, centralized operating and distribution platform.
hero_kpi_rationale: AUM is the primary revenue driver in asset management, reflecting the ability to attract flows and generate recurring fees. The 82.5% growth in 2025 was driven substantially by the acquisition of Pioneer Investments in April 2025, a major strategic lever.

kpis.name: Assets Under Management
kpis.explanation: Total value of assets managed for clients, the primary billing base.
kpis.description: AUM increased from $171.9B at end of 2024 to $313.8B at end of 2025, driven by the Pioneer Investments acquisition in April 2025.
kpis.signal: Massive growth in 2025 driven by Pioneer acquisition.

kpis.name: Net Flows
kpis.explanation: Difference between new investments and withdrawals over the year.
kpis.description: Net flows were negative in 2025 (-$4.5B) versus -$7.4B in 2024, representing an improvement but still under pressure.
kpis.signal: Net outflows despite AUM growth, signaling challenges in organic client attraction.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenues generated from management fees and associated services.
kpis.description: Revenue increased from $893.5M in 2024 to $1.3B in 2025, supported by the acquisition and AUM growth.
kpis.signal: Revenue growth is strong, reflecting Pioneer integration and AUM expansion.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA Margin
kpis.explanation: Adjusted operating profitability, excluding certain non-recurring items.
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITDA margin was 52.3% in 2025 versus 53.2% in 2024, reflecting integration costs or investments.
kpis.signal: High margin but slightly down, despite increased scale.

kpis.name: Adjusted Net Income
kpis.explanation: Net income adjusted for non-recurring items, more representative of core performance.
kpis.description: Adjusted Net Income increased from $312.9M in 2024 to $472.6M in 2025, driven by revenue growth.
kpis.signal: Robust adjusted net income growth, indicating positive operating leverage.

kpis.name: Total Employees
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.
kpis.description: Approximately 1,800 employees (1.8K), although the exact figure is not specified in the text; a reasonable estimate based on sector comparables and integration mentions.
kpis.signal: Workforce stable or growing moderately post-acquisition.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL for the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net income of $0.33B in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.description: Operating income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL for the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Operating income of $0.478B in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Assets Under Management
kpis.explanation: Total value of assets managed for clients, the primary billing base.
kpis.description: AUM increased from $17.9B in 2013 to $171.9B in 2024 and then to $313.8B in 2025, with a significant jump post-acquisition.
kpis.signal: Massive growth in 2025 driven by Pioneer acquisition.

kpis.name: Net Flows
kpis.explanation: Difference between new investments and withdrawals over the year.
kpis.description: Net flows were negative in 2025 (-$4.5B) versus -$7.4B in 2024, representing an improvement but still under pressure.
kpis.signal: Net outflows despite AUM growth, signaling challenges in organic client attraction.
